title: Re-point platform-core.url-overlay-contract: the record page addresses its tabs with ?related=, not ?tab=, and one Back returns to the record
body:
qa#1 · zhuangjianguo · session_01QsR2jUARzLeR7GhKms8a5s

QA-source: #31486 · platform-core.url-overlay-contract · acceptance[2]

A stale-spec FAIL in the QA run #31486 (subject `0647dabb`), rule R-2 there (acceptance[1] tab half, acceptance[2], negative[0] tab half). The capability holds under the current parameter; the item names the retired one.

## What the shipped record page does

`RecordDetailView.tsx`, lines 844–878 (with `RECORD_RELATED_ENLARGE_PARAM` in `urlParams.ts`): the tab row writes `?related=OBJECT.FIELD`. Leaving Overview pushes one history entry; moving between tabs replaces it; Back, Esc or Overview return to the record in one step. `?tab=` is not read on a columns record page. A cold load of `…?related=showcase_contact.account` lands on the Contacts tab.

## The re-point

In `docs/qa/platform-checklist/areas/platform-core.json`, item `platform-core.url-overlay-contract`:

- steps[3]: "append `?related=showcase_contact.account` (a cold load lands on that tab); switch tabs several times and press Back once: you return to the record's Overview in one step, never back through tab selections";
- acceptance[1]: tab switches add at most one entry (the first leave of Overview); palette and shortcuts add none;
- acceptance[2]: `?related=OBJECT.FIELD` cold-loads the tab;
- negative[0]: the same, for the tab half.

Bump the revision and add a history entry.
